thread: Tired of textbook dialogues? Try reading real Chinese history instead. HSK Path now has 15 true stories written in pinyin, from Confucius to Yuan Longping. 🧵 #learnchinese #HSK

2/ Meet the people who shaped China:

Zheng He and his seven voyages. Li Bai, the immortal poet. Cai Lun and paper. Tu Youyou and artemisinin. Yuan Longping and hybrid rice.

Almost nobody learns this in a vocabulary list.

3/ Stuck on a word? Tap it to see the meaning.

Stuck on a sentence? Open the English translation for that paragraph. You can also listen to the audio and show the 汉字 when you're ready.

4/ They're long reads (25 to 40 minutes), so you can stop and continue later. Each one ends with a comprehension quiz, so you know you really understood it.

Prefer something shorter? There are 15 legends too, 7 to 15 minutes each.

5/ Which person from Chinese history would you read about first? Reply below 👇

Repost to help another HSK learner 🔁
https://hsk-path-eosin.vercel.app
bonus: HSK 1 word of the day: 飞机 (fēijī). 飞 = to fly, 机 = machine. Can you guess what a "flying machine" is? Now try this one: how would you say "I take the plane" in Chinese? Reply below! #learnchinese #HSK
